assertion: An ancestor overflow clip applies after the descendant backdrop/content blend. The visible control retains the protruding filter; the hidden control cuts both backdrop and foreground at the ancestor boundary.

browser.reason: Reviewed PNGs and difference images. Chrome preserves the filtered backdrop and applies foreground blending before final source-over; Firefox/WebKit captures omit invert even in the standalone control in this environment. See ../backdrop-blend/README.md. Only one output channel level differs across 15100 translucent pixels; geometry and opaque regions were reviewed.
